bindings.reviewed_card: H-NF19-16 — Глобальные моменты WP вместо локальных batch-отношений

design_assessment.clipping_and_scorer_limit: Both objectives receive the same clipped prediction and therefore avoid a loss-arm clipping asymmetry. The pooled-correlation loss remains a stabilized differentiable surrogate with sqrt(vy*vp+1e-12), not the official scorer’s exact near-degenerate convention; the design discloses this and should retain tiny finite-gradient/zero-variance checks.
design_assessment.fixed_comparison: The design reuses one R3 fit/eval panel and one newly seeded 224→64 GELU mean/unused-variance model. Both arms use the same fit-only normalization, all 31,808 stride rows, initial state, 128 full-fit updates, AdamW settings, and clipped predictions q=clamp(raw_mean,-2,2). No evaluation-based selection or prior endpoint tuning is specified.
design_assessment.interpretation_limit: Even with initial norm matching, the objectives can produce different later gradients, clipping frequencies, and AdamW trajectories. A score difference is conditional on this exposed adaptive panel, architecture, seed, and 128-step budget; it cannot establish WMSE’s population-optimum failure, a general WP-loss advantage, fresh-holdout performance, or equal-time efficiency.
design_assessment.objective_scope: The control is canonical globally normalized pooled WMSE on q; the candidate is a fixed positive scale times canonical stabilized global pooled weighted correlation on the same q. Both objectives use full-fit global statistics, so this does not isolate global moments versus local batch ratios. The intended comparison is a finite-budget objective/gradient treatment.
design_assessment.resource_feasibility: Two arms × 128 full-fit updates × 31,808 rows = 8,142,848 row exposures. The 224×64 MLP and in-memory fit batch appear compatible with the 0.5 CPU, 1.5 GB, 600 s cap. Runtime is the main uncertainty; retain the exact hard cap and mark the comparison incomplete if both arms do not finish, without a retry or budget expansion.
design_assessment.scale_matching: gamma=||grad L_WMSE(theta0)||/||grad L_corr(theta0)|| on all fit rows, computed once before optimization and excluding the unused variance head and AdamW decay. It matches only initial aggregate gradient norms. The finite/nonzero check and predeclared [1e-4,1e4] range fail closed without tuning.

pre_code_checks_to_preserve: Tiny fixtures verify scorer/loss agreement in nondegenerate cases, finite gradients for zero-weight and zero-variance cases, and finite differences or autograd for both objectives through the shared clamp.
Verify gamma excludes unused variance parameters and optimizer decay, is computed once on fit rows only, and does not mutate model parameters or .grad fields.
Pin the complete import closure and run source/read sentinels before data access; confirm actual python -m entrypoint provenance.
Require exactly 128 successful updates per arm, zero nonfinite events, and preserved initialization/fingerprint; otherwise report an incomplete pair.
review_limits: Design-only review. No code, arrays, model, fit, or remote resources were accessed.
